description: A region's close outcome is the join of its tasks' outcomes, folded as each completes, and two Cancelled outcomes join by strengthening only when the right kind is strictly more severe (Outcome::join, types/outcome.rs:566-581). r.up: t.u1 is cancelled User at 20 and completes first, t.u2 Shutdown at 30: the later, stronger reason wins (Shutdown, 30). r.down: t.d1 Shutdown at 40 completes first, t.d2 User at 50: the earlier, stronger reason stays. r.tie: t.e1 Deadline at 60 completes first (its timer fires in the step that follows the entry at 75), t.e2 Timeout at 55 completes last (its timer fires in the step that follows the entry at 205), and the close outcome is read at 215, after both are folded; the two kinds have the same severity and the right one has the earlier timestamp, which CancelReason::strengthen alone would prefer, but join does not call it on a tie: the left reason, Deadline at 60, stays. Neither Timeout nor Deadline cuts a sleep short, so those tasks observe their cancel at the checkpoint after their sleep; t.h1 to t.h3 are cancelled only so that the scheduler has something to run when the clock jumps to an entry, and that step fires the timers that are due. An entry's op is applied before the step that follows it, so a read in the entry of a completion's own step sees nothing of it.
